notes.title: Update 0.65 New Monster, story beats and more!
notes.content: [h3]Patch 0.65 Notes — Highlights[/h3][p][b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New Monster:[/b] A fresh bedside stalker with its own audio tells. Watch, hide, or die.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Environmental Story Beats:[/b] Rooms now sprout unsettling objects and drawings at unpredictable times, revealing fragments of the crash and its aftermath.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Escalating Difficulty:[/b] Every dawn shortens reaction windows and speeds up attack cycles. Surviving gets harder night-by-night.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Experience Tweaks[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Night-End Overhaul:[/b] No more black-screen . Blink once and you'll be awake.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance / Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Spawn timings tightened to keep pressure consistent.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor audio stingers re-EQ’d for clearer directional cues.[/p][/*][/list]
